name: Claude API Usage
author: Kyle Arrington
description: Claude API spend against a monthly credit: a pace gauge on the bar and a flyout with daily trend, today by hour, and breakdowns by model, API key and token type. Uses the Anthropic Admin API.

barWidget.description: Pace gauge (credit used vs cycle elapsed). Click for the flyout, right click refreshes, middle click opens the Console cost page.

schema.label: Monthly credit (USD)
schema.description: Budget to pace against, e.g. the API credit included with a Max plan ($100 on 5x, $200 on 20x).

schema.label: Credit cycle start day
schema.description: Day of the month the credit refreshes (UTC).

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: Cost data lags by up to a day; usage by about 5 minutes. Results are cached for a minute across monitors.

schema.label: Admin key variable
schema.description: Environment variable that holds the Admin API key.

schema.label: Key wrapper command
schema.description: Optional command prefix that runs the fetch script with the key variable set, e.g. 'op run --env-file=/path/to/env --'. Leave empty to use the variable or the key file.

schema.label: Demo data
schema.description: Show made-up numbers instead of calling the API (for screenshots or trying it out).
